no_adcom_quote.quote: No major review issues were identified during the review of this application and thus, the review team did not seek input from external consultants or refer the application to the Oncologic Drug Advisory Committee.

summary: No advisory committee meeting was convened for the QINLOCK (ripretinib) NDA213973 approval. The Multi-Discipline Review states that because no major review issues were identified, the review team did not seek input from external consultants or refer the application to the Oncologic Drugs Advisory Committee. Accordingly, there are no AdComm-driven linkages to the approval.
